items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Oh, Piron. Piron. Piron. Piron. He was a cripple guy. Used to play a left hand violin.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's the one. We just played some of his records yesterday.

Yeah. Tiro. Because I remember when Robichaud was going to New York, he was, Maison Blanche I think, is the one who financed the whole trip when they did their first recording and went to New York. Robichaud. Yeah, Robichaud with the band. Oh, Piron. Piron. Piron. Piron. He was a cripple guy. Used to play a left hand violin. Sure. And the last dance to give, I remember it was at the Knights of Pison Hall I think, somewhere up here on Ramport Street. And I happened to go to the dance.
What were some of Buddy Petit's tunes?
